title: Reshape a Tensor
instructions: Reshape a 1D tensor of 6 elements into a 2x3 matrix.
starterCode:
const flat = tf.tensor([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]);
const matrix = null; // reshape to [2, 3]
solutionCode:
const flat = tf.tensor([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]);
const matrix = flat.reshape([2, 3]);

title: Normalize Sensor Data
instructions: Apply z-score normalization to a tensor of sensor readings.
starterCode:
const data = tf.tensor([10, 20, 30, 40, 50]);
const normalized = null; // apply z-score normalization
solutionCode:
const data = tf.tensor([10, 20, 30, 40, 50]);
const normalized = data.sub(data.mean()).div(data.std());
